com.desertpants.source: Visual language derived from desertant.com (brand/index.css, assets/site.css, captured 2026-09-23/24). Logos, marks, product names, photography and copy are not included.

radius.$description: Blur applied to text in the blur effect.

shift.$description: Vertical echo offset of the blur effect (text-shadow 1x and 2x).

paper-opacity.$description: Opacity of the paper layer of grained headlines.

offset.$description: Vertical offset of the front grain layer.

alpha-gain.$description: Noise alpha gain (feColorMatrix alpha row, first term).

alpha-offset.$description: Noise alpha offset (feColorMatrix alpha row, last term).

region-x.$description: Filter region x, relative to the text box (%).

blur.$description: Soft back layer. Blur of the glyph alpha before the noise is subtracted.

edge.$description: Soft back layer. Weight of the blurred glyph against the noise (arithmetic k2).

contrast.$description: Soft back layer. Stipple contrast (alpha slope).

blur.$description: Crisp front layer. Blur of the glyph alpha before the noise is subtracted.

edge.$description: Crisp front layer. Weight of the blurred glyph against the noise (arithmetic k2).

contrast.$description: Crisp front layer. Stipple contrast (alpha slope).

blur.$description: Paper-coloured layer that bites into the ink. Blur of the glyph alpha before the noise is subtracted.

seed.$description: Paper-coloured layer that bites into the ink. Noise seed.

edge.$description: Paper-coloured layer that bites into the ink. Weight of the blurred glyph against the noise (arithmetic k2).

contrast.$description: Paper-coloured layer that bites into the ink. Stipple contrast (alpha slope).

max.$description: Largest pixel block (px) at the start of the pixelate effect.

hold-ratio.$description: Pixelate hold variant: resting block size as a fraction of the maximum.

passes.$description: Noise: jittered copies painted per frame.

settle-spread.$description: Noise: share of the spread kept in the jitter radius as the effect settles (the radius eases from max to spread x this).

ms-per-100px.$description: Draw-in speed: milliseconds per 100px of path.

gap.$description: Gap between contour lines, relative to glyph size.

lines.$description: Contour: number of offset outlines drawn around the word.

threshold.$description: Share of an element that must be visible before its reveal or effect starts.

inset-bottom.$description: The trigger area stops this far above the bottom of the viewport (% of its height), so effects start once the element is clearly in view.

color.$description: Highlighter marker ink: multiplied into the paper in light mode; in dark mode a deep teal band drawn normally behind cream text.

sweep-angle.$description: Direction the ink fills outlined text (deg; 90 = from the start edge). The fill is a hard-stop gradient twice the text width that slides across (effect.outline stroke, motion.transition.outline-fill).

mark.$description: Hand-drawn marks drawn over text (strike, underline, circle and the rest). Stroke = ratio x the host line box height, never below the minimum.

stroke-ratio.$description: Strike-through scribble. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Hand-drawn underline. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Thick marker underline. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Speech-bubble outline. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

pad-x.$description: Speech bubble: space between the word and the outline, left and right (added to 7% of the word width).

pad-y.$description: Speech bubble: space between the word and the outline, above and below (added to 12% of the line box).

corner-max.$description: Speech bubble: largest corner size (the corner is 55% of the line box up to this).

close-overshoot-x.$description: Speech bubble: how far the stroke runs past its start where it closes, horizontally (the hand-drawn overlap).

close-overshoot-y.$description: Speech bubble: how far the closing stroke drifts from its start, vertically.

stroke-ratio.$description: Zig-zag scribble. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Emphasis rays. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Hand-drawn circle. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Hand-drawn box. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Focus corners. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Wavy underline. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Cut line. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Question squiggle. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.
Highlighter band behind the word. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

stroke-min.$description: Highlighter band behind the word. Minimum stroke.

stroke-ratio.$description: Redaction bar over the word. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

stroke-min.$description: Redaction bar over the word. Minimum stroke.

stroke-ratio.$description: Measured rule with end ticks. Stroke as a fraction of the line box height.

stroke-min.$description: Measured rule with end ticks. Minimum stroke.

bleed.$description: Room left around every mark's path inside its drawing box, so strokes and their round caps are never clipped. The room is transparent.

in.$description: Redact: bar draws across the word.

hold.$description: Redact: bar holds on hover before lifting.

out.$description: Redact: bar lifts off the word.

hold.$description: Wipe: hold between sweeps on hover.

edge.$description: Wipe: width of the soft sweep edge as a fraction of the word width.

duration.$description: Dissolve: particles settle into the word.

particles.$description: Dissolve: target number of particles across the word box (the particle size follows).

stagger.$description: Dissolve: particles start moving across this share of the sweep, one after another.

window.$description: Dissolve: share of the sweep one particle takes to leave or return.

sweep.$description: Dissolve: length of the whole sweep in the same units: stagger plus window, plus a hold while every particle is away.

scatter-x.$description: Dissolve: horizontal scatter range of a particle, in line box heights (centred on its place in the word).

rise-min.$description: Dissolve: least a particle rises, in line box heights.

rise-range.$description: Dissolve: extra rise a particle may take on top of rise-min, in line box heights.

duration.$description: Speak: the word types in behind a voice meter.

bars.$description: Speak: bars in the voice meter that leads the reveal.

bar-width.$description: Speak: meter bar width as a fraction of the line box height.

bar-height.$description: Speak: tallest meter bar, above and below the centre line, as a fraction of the line box height (bars shorten towards the tail).

bar-jitter.$description: Speak: a bar's height varies between this share of its height and the full height, redrawn each frame.

bar-pitch.$description: Speak: distance from one bar's start to the next, in bar widths. The gap before the first bar, at the reveal edge, matches the gap between bars.

origin-y.$description: Heartbeat ring transform origin, vertical (%): slightly below centre, under the glyph's optical middle.

start-opacity.$description: Ring opacity as a beat starts.

beat-scale.$description: Ring scale at the first beat (14% of the cycle).

beat-opacity.$description: Ring opacity at the first beat.

echo-scale.$description: Ring scale as it settles between beats (26% of the cycle).

echo-opacity.$description: Ring opacity as it settles between beats.

peak-scale.$description: Largest ring scale in a beat (42% to the end of the cycle, fading out).

title-deco.$description: Hand-drawn title decorations, positioned in % of the title box.

played.$description: Played portion of media progress on dark fills.

theme.fixed: media controls sit on video and photographs, whose colours no theme changes

unplayed.$description: Unplayed portion of media progress on dark fills.

theme.fixed: media controls sit on video and photographs, whose colours no theme changes

gradient.$description: Gradients: functional scrims and fades only (behind text on photos, or blending a fill into a photo). Never decorative.

photo-scrim.$description: Bottom-up scrim behind text set on photographs (covers the lower 62%).

theme.fixed: sits on photographs, whose colours no theme changes
sits on video, whose colours no theme changes

hero-side.$description: Left edge of a sage fill-hero photo (covers 54% of the width).

hero-top.$description: Top of a sage fill-hero photo behind the header (height: 2 x header height).

hero-top-compact.$description: Top of a sage fill-hero photo at 860px and below (covers 46% of the height).
